title: VT Connect
tagline: Real-time voice assistant API for interaction with blockchain
description: This project demonstrates a real-time voice assistant API that captures user actions and transforms them into blockchain interactions. As a demo use case, we use an on-chain reservation system for "The Blockchain Hotel," where reservations are modeled as NFTs. The voice assistant queries the user for check-in and check-out dates, checks if the corresponding NFTs are not minted, and if available, initiates a mint transaction.
